grammar.pattern: 介宾 / 方位 / 兼语 / 同位短语
grammar.explanation: 介宾: 跟朋友 / 在教室, preposition plus its object. 方位: 桌子上 / 教室里面, referent plus location word. 兼语: 请朋友介绍, where 朋友 is both the object of 请 and the subject of 介绍. 同位: 老师张先生, where two expressions identify the same person. Do not interpret apposition as two teachers or a pivot construction as two unrelated events.

examples.zh: 我跟朋友在教室里面见面。

commonMistakes.right: 老师张先生指同一个人。
commonMistakes.why: The two appositive expressions refer to the same person.

grammar.pattern: 大主语 + 小主语 + 谓语
grammar.purpose: Read the larger topic and its internal statement
grammar.explanation: A subject–predicate phrase can itself be the predicate: 她汉语说得很流利. 她 is the larger subject; 汉语说得很流利 says something about her Chinese. Similarly 这篇文章内容很清楚 has 这篇文章 as the larger subject and 内容很清楚 as its predicate. This is not a request to add a comma or 是 between every pair of nouns.

examples.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō dé hěn liú lì .
zhè piān wén zhāng nèi róng hěn qīng chǔ .

examples.zh: 他组织活动的本领很强。
examples.py: tā zǔ zhī huó dòng de běn lǐng hěn qiáng .
examples.en: His ability to organize events is strong.

commonMistakes.why: Do not add 是 to this ordinary subject–predicate construction.

dialogue.title: The friend in the introduction
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Identify the friend and what is actually known about her.

lines.zh: 你提过的那位朋友，是我们班级里的那位吗？
lines.py: nǐ tí guò de nà wèi péng you , shì wǒ men bān jí lǐ de nà wèi ma ?
lines.en: Is the friend you mentioned the one in our class?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。她汉语说得很流利，写作也有本领。
lines.py: duì . tā hàn yǔ shuō dé hěn liú lì , xiě zuò yě yǒu běn lǐng .
lines.en: Yes. She speaks Chinese fluently and has writing ability.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我只看过她的文章，表面上显得很安静。
lines.py: wǒ zhǐ kàn guò tā de wén zhāng , biǎo miàn shàng xiǎn de hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: I have only read her article; she seems quiet on the surface.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 表面不能代替评价。她处理活动很成熟。
lines.py: biǎo miàn bù néng dài tì píng jià . tā chǔ lǐ huó dòng hěn chéng shú .
lines.en: Appearance cannot replace assessment; she handles events maturely.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她的职业是什么？杂志上没有写。
lines.py: tā de zhí yè shì shén me ? zá zhì shàng méi yǒu xiě .
lines.en: What is her occupation? The magazine did not state it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这个先问她。介绍的形式可以换，事实得确认。
lines.py: zhè gè xiān wèn tā . jiè shào de xíng shì kě yǐ huàn , shì shí dé què rèn .
lines.en: Ask her first; the introduction’s format can change, but facts need confirmation.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那请她介绍自己的长处和短处。
lines.py: nà qǐng tā jiè shào zì jǐ de cháng chù hé duǎn chù .
lines.en: Then ask her to introduce her own strengths and weaknesses.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，老师张先生也可以听，但让她先说。
lines.py: hǎo , lǎo shī zhāng xiān shēng yě kě yǐ tīng , dàn ràng tā xiān shuō .
lines.en: Okay; teacher Mr Zhang can listen too, but let her speak first.
lines.speaker: b

reading.purpose: Read how the draft is checked with its subject.

lines.zh: 写作开始前，读者需要知道这位朋友是谁，不能只看屏幕显示的名字。
lines.py: xiě zuò kāi shǐ qián , dú zhě xū yào zhī dào zhè wèi péng you shì shéi , bù néng zhǐ kàn píng mù xiǎn shì de míng zi .
lines.en: Before writing, readers need to know who this friend is, beyond the displayed name.

lines.zh: 我们在班级认识，门口的保安帮过忙，这些是可以确认的事情。
lines.py: wǒ men zài bān jí rèn shi , mén kǒu de bǎo ān bāng guò máng , zhè xiē shì kě yǐ què rèn de shì qíng .
lines.en: We met in class and the entrance guard helped us; these are confirmable events.

lines.zh: 她汉语说得很流利，文章内容很清楚；这两句各有一个内部主谓结构。
lines.py: tā hàn yǔ shuō dé hěn liú lì , wén zhāng nèi róng hěn qīng chǔ ; zhè liǎng jù gè yǒu yī gè nèi bù zhǔ wèi jié gòu .
lines.en: She speaks Chinese fluently and the article’s content is clear; each contains an internal subject–predicate structure.

lines.zh: 她的本领和本事要看实际做过的事，了解的程度也要说明。
lines.py: tā de běn lǐng hé běn shi yào kàn shí jì zuò guò de shì , liǎo jiě de chéng dù yě yào shuō míng .
lines.en: Her abilities should be judged from actual actions, and the extent of our knowledge stated.

lines.zh: 认真观察作品，评价具体长处与短处；基础还在练，不等于没有能力。
lines.py: rèn zhēn guān chá zuò pǐn , píng jià jù tǐ cháng chù yǔ duǎn chù ; jī chǔ hái zài liàn , bù děng yú méi yǒu néng lì .
lines.en: Observe the work carefully and assess specific strengths and weaknesses; still practising foundations does not mean having no ability.

lines.zh: 成熟是这次处理问题给人的形象，不是对所有未来行为的保证。
lines.py: chéng shú shì zhè cì chǔ lǐ wèn tí gěi rén de xíng xiàng , bù shì duì suǒ yǒu wèi lái xíng wéi de bǎo zhèng .
lines.en: Maturity is the impression from this handling of a problem, not a guarantee of all future behaviour.

lines.zh: 文字的形式改变不了现实，杂志介绍的事实由她自己确认。
lines.py: wén zì de xíng shì gǎi biàn bù le xiàn shí , zá zhì jiè shào de shì shí yóu tā zì jǐ què rèn .
lines.en: A text’s format cannot change reality; she confirms the facts in the magazine introduction.

lines.zh: 她的回答表明职业暂时不写，也让介绍显得更尊重本人。
lines.py: tā de huí dá biǎo míng zhí yè zàn shí bù xiě , yě ràng jiè shào xiǎn de gèng zūn zhòng běn rén .
lines.en: Her response indicates the occupation will be omitted for now, making the introduction more respectful.
